JWST:9828.aim: We propose JWST/MIRI F2550W imaging of a carefully selected sample of debris disks around Sun-like stars within 25 pc whose cold, outer belts of planetesimals have been well-characterized by resolved millimeter observations.

JWST:12637.aim: The routine wavefront sensing and control (WFS&C) maintenance calibration program is necessary to fulfill a Level 1 Mission requirement on image quality.

JWST:13006.aim: This observing proposal will target 3 different regions of a cloud complex around a stellar cluster with NIRCam, and one of them with MIRI.

JWST:10108.aim: We propose JWST/NIRSpec and NIRCam observations of the massive protostellar jet system RAFGL2591 to directly link shock physics with the onset of non-thermal emission.

JWST:10830.aim: JWST has detected a class of high-z galaxies, termed N-emitters, characterized by their elevated N/O abundances relative to O/H.

JWST:11441.aim: We propose establishing a JWST Spectral Library for Cool Stars, providing high-precision, flux-calibrated spectra critical for validating and refining current stellar model atmospheres.

JWST:10149.aim: These systems are theorized to undergo stochastic cycles of bursting and “dormant” phases, but the specific feedback mechanisms responsible are difficult to constrain observationally.
